d: A massive, bloated demon with pale greyish-white skin, featuring a cavernous, tooth-filled maw for a face and several small, blinking eyes scattered across its forehead. It possesses a colossal, flabby torso with two short, thick arms ending in three blunt claws per hand and a wide, flat base instead of legs. The creature has a thick, fleshy, tapering tail that ends in a blunt, boneless point. BODY COLOR: pale greyish-white
